title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
abstract: arXiv:2611.30361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lean verifies that a proof establishes its formal proposition, but whether that proposition preserves the mathematical content of an informal source requires separate review. In project-scale formalizations, this correspondence can depend on definitions and constraints distributed across many declarations. We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs collected from 18 real Lean projects, with 87 aligned and 110 misaligned reference judgments. Each input binds an informal mathematical target to selected formal declarations and an extracted dependency context. Construction combines development-history discovery, independent target binding, reconstruction under a common Lean environment, and Astra annotation with human review of uncertain cases. The collection spans diverse mathematical domains and includes 69 historical pairs. We evaluate six language models with Dire

translated_title: LeanReviewBench：数学Lean项目中的语义对齐审查
translated_abstract: Lean能够验证一个证明是否确立了其形式化命题，但该命题是否保留了非形式化数学源的内容则需要单独的审查。在项目规模的形式化工作中，这种对应关系可能依赖于分布在众多声明中的定义与约束。我们提出了LeanReviewBench，一个用于项目级语义对齐审查的基准，其中包含从18个真实Lean项目中收集的197个带版本信息的输入，共有87个对齐参考判断和110个未对齐参考判断。每个输入将一个非形式化数学目标绑定到选定的形式化声明以及提取出的依赖上下文。该数据集的构建结合了开发历史发现、独立目标绑定、在统一Lean环境下的重构，以及Astra标注并对不确定情况进行人工审查。该数据集涵盖多样化的数学领域，并包含69个历史配对。我们使用Dire（原文在此处截断）评估了六个语言模型……
tldr: 提出了LeanReviewBench——一个包含来自18个真实Lean项目的197个标注输入的项目级基准，用于评估语言模型审查非形式化数学目标与形式化Lean命题之间语义对齐的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces LeanReviewBench, a project-level benchmark of 197 annotated inputs from 18 real Lean projects for evaluating language models on reviewing semantic alignment between informal mathematical targets and formal Lean propositions.
